name: Amazon Aurora
description_en:
Amazon Aurora is an AWS-managed relational database service with MySQL-compatible and PostgreSQL-compatible engines, operated through Amazon RDS. Its cluster model separates database compute from distributed storage. This profile covers those Aurora engines; the pricing page treats Aurora DSQL separately, so its architecture and charges are not merged into this record.

A practical evaluation connects an application to the appropriate writer/reader endpoints, checks engine compatibility and authorization, and exercises failure and restore paths with disposable data. AWS manages infrastructure, but schema design, query tuning, access configuration and application behavior remain the operator’s work. No AWS account, cluster, connection or billable action was operated.
description_zh:
Amazon Aurora 是由 Amazon RDS 管理的 AWS 关系数据库服务，提供 MySQL 及 PostgreSQL 兼容引擎，集群将数据库计算与分布式存储分开。本文覆盖这两类引擎；定价页单列 Aurora DSQL，因此不合并其架构及费用。

建议将应用接到正确的写／读端点，检查引擎兼容性及授权，再用可丢弃数据验证故障及恢复路径。AWS 管理基础设施，模式设计、查询调优、访问配置及应用行为仍由使用方负责。本次未操作 AWS 账户、集群、连接或计费动作。

core_features.explanation_en: Use Aurora MySQL or Aurora PostgreSQL through RDS management interfaces.
core_features.explanation_zh: 通过 RDS 管理接口使用 Aurora MySQL 或 Aurora PostgreSQL。

core_features.explanation_en: Writer and optional readers use a distributed cluster volume.
core_features.explanation_zh: 写实例及可选读实例使用分布式集群卷。

core_features.explanation_en: Distribute new reader connections among available replicas.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在可用副本间分配新的读取连接。

core_features.explanation_en: Supported serverless configurations can auto-pause at a0ACU minimum.
core_features.explanation_zh: 受支持的 serverless 配置可在最小0ACU 时自动暂停。

core_features.explanation_en: Restore retained backup data into a new cluster.
core_features.explanation_zh: 将保留的备份数据恢复到新集群。

steps.en: Choose engine/version/region and test schema/client compatibility on disposable data.
steps.zh: 选择引擎／版本／区域，以可丢弃数据测试模式及客户端兼容性。

steps.en: Inspect SQL grants, network/TLS and writer/reader connection handling.
steps.zh: 检查 SQL 授权、网络／TLS 及写／读连接处理。

steps.en: Evaluate topology, restore points, pause behavior and all cost meters before production.
steps.zh: 生产前评估拓扑、恢复点、暂停行为及全部计费项。

items.en: A reader endpoint can reach a writable primary when no replicas exist.
items.zh: 无副本时读端点可能连接可写主实例。

items.en: Auto-pause does not wake for or queue engine-scheduled jobs missed while paused.
items.zh: 自动暂停不会因引擎定时任务唤醒，也不排队补跑暂停期间错过任务。

items.en: Point-in-time restoration creates a new cluster and does not establish zero data loss or automatic application cutover.
items.zh: 时间点恢复创建新集群，不证明零数据丢失或应用自动切换。

pricing.summary_en: Usage-based instance or ACU compute plus storage/I/O and optional services; configuration/engine/region matter. New-customer credits are time-limited, not a forever-free deployment.
pricing.summary_zh: 实例或 ACU 计算加存储／I/O 及可选服务按量，受配置／引擎／区域影响；新客户抵扣有期限，非永久免费部署。

review_notes: Original AI research draft based on the cited public official pages; no publication, price approval, independent review or product test is implied.
Earlier third-party feature and price claims are retained only in discovery provenance, not as current product evidence.

sections.title_en: Storage redundancy and reader capacity solve different problems
sections.title_zh: 存储冗余与读取容量处理不同问题
sections.en: An Aurora cluster has a writer and can add up to15 readers sharing the cluster volume. Even one database instance is a cluster because the storage spans multiple Availability Zones. Readers provide query capacity and failover targets; distributed storage alone does not place database compute in multiple AZs. For a proposed order service, inspect where the writer/readers run and which failure the topology actually tolerates before equating a cluster label with an available application.
sections.zh: Aurora 集群包含写实例，可增加最多15个共享集群卷的读实例。即便仅一个数据库实例，存储跨多个可用区仍构成集群。读实例提供查询容量及故障接管目标；仅存储分布不等于数据库计算跨区。建议订单服务检查写／读实例位置及拓扑可容忍的故障，不能将集群标签等同应用可用。

sections.title_en: Reader endpoints are not a read-only permission policy
sections.title_zh: 读端点不是只读权限策略
sections.en: The reader endpoint balances connections, not individual queries. A long-lived pooled connection stays with its selected instance. With replicas, those sessions are read-only, but with no replicas the same reader endpoint connects to the primary and permits writes. Apply database grants independently and check actual routing, read freshness and read-after-write requirements. A reporting connection named reader is not evidence that an application user cannot modify data.
sections.zh: 读端点分配的是连接而非每条查询，长连接池会保持所选实例。有副本时对应会话只读，无副本时同一个读端点连接主实例且允许写入。应独立设置数据库授权，检查真实路由、读取新鲜度及写后读要求；报表连接名为 reader 不证明应用用户不能修改数据。

sections.title_en: Failover still requires application recovery behavior
sections.title_zh: 故障接管仍需应用恢复行为
sections.en: AWS describes replica promotion or writer recreation after a failure, with an interval in which operations can raise exceptions. The cluster endpoint follows the current writer, while instance-specific addresses and connection caches need care. Distribute compute across AZs according to the intended outage scenario. Test connection recovery and uncertain transaction outcomes using idempotent application operations; no failover timing, zero-downtime result or cross-region recovery objective was measured here.
sections.zh: AWS 说明故障后可提升副本或重建写实例，其间操作可能返回异常。集群端点跟随当前写实例，实例专属地址及连接缓存则需留意。应按预期故障配置跨区计算，以幂等应用操作测试重连和事务结果不确定情形；本次未测接管时间、零停机结果或跨区域恢复目标。

sections.title_en: Management permission, network reachability and SQL grants differ
sections.title_zh: 管理权限、网络可达及 SQL 授权不同
sections.en: Aurora security documentation separates IAM permissions to manage resources, VPC/security-group connectivity, TLS/encryption and engine-level database access. A console permission does not itself establish the SQL privileges an application needs. Before a connection test, choose the exact engine/version and review required extensions, schema behavior, client credentials and network route. AWS’s compatibility statement does not replace testing the actual workload or tuning its queries.
sections.zh: Aurora 安全文档区分 IAM 资源管理、VPC／安全组连接、TLS／加密及引擎数据库权限。控制台权限本身不代表应用所需 SQL 权限。连接测试前应选定引擎／版本，并检查扩展、模式行为、客户端凭据及网络路径。AWS 的兼容声明不能替代真实工作负载测试或查询调优。

sections.title_en: Zero ACUs does not mean every background task will run
sections.title_zh: 零 ACU 不保证后台任务执行
sections.en: Auto-pause requires a supported engine version, compatible settings and minimum capacity0. Incompatible combinations may simply stay active without an error. Connecting resumes a paused instance—even an invalid-credential attempt can wake it. The guide explicitly says pg_cron/MySQL scheduled events do not wake it and missed jobs are skipped rather than queued. Evaluate connection latency and scheduled work separately. Pausing removes instance-capacity charges, not an assumed storage or backup bill.
sections.zh: 自动暂停需支持的引擎版本、兼容设置及最小容量0；不兼容组合可能无报错地持续运行。连接会唤醒暂停实例，即便无效凭据尝试也能唤醒。指南明确 pg_cron／MySQL 定时事件不会唤醒，错过的任务跳过而非排队。需分别评估连接延迟和定时工作；暂停取消实例容量费，不代表存储或备份账单归零。

sections.title_en: Restoring creates another cluster that needs verification
sections.title_zh: 恢复创建另一个需验证的集群
sections.en: Automated backup retention is configurable from1 to35 days, with a documented one-day default. Point-in-time recovery creates a new cluster; the latest restorable moment is typically within five minutes of the active cluster’s current time. Check the actual earliest/latest restorable values, restored data, permissions and application endpoint before any cutover. Snapshots persist beyond normal retention and may cost money after the source is deleted. Backups do not reverse messages or other external writes.
sections.zh: 自动备份可配置保留1至35天，文档默认一天。时间点恢复创建新集群，最新可恢复点通常在活跃集群当前时间前五分钟内。切换前需检查实际最早／最新恢复点、数据、权限及应用端点。快照可超出常规保留期，源集群删除后仍可能收费；备份不会撤销消息等外部写入。

sections.title_en: Compute is only one part of an Aurora estimate
sections.title_zh: 计算只是 Aurora 估价的一部分
sections.en: The price model meters writer and reader compute, storage and optional features. Standard adds read/write I/O; I/O-Optimized folds those operations into its different instance/storage prices, but global replicated writes still have charges. Serverless capacity uses ACU-seconds, while provisioned capacity uses instance time; reservations do not include all storage and transfer. Data API also meters32KB payload increments. New-customer credits are time-limited. No region-specific rate, total workload quote or sustained-free plan is asserted.
sections.zh: 费用包含写／读计算、存储及可选功能。Standard 另计读写 I/O，I/O-Optimized 将其纳入不同实例／存储价格，但全球复制写仍收费。Serverless 按 ACU 秒，预置按实例时间；预留不包全部存储及传输。Data API 还按32KB 载荷增量计数。新客户抵扣有期限；不虚构地区费率、完整工作负载报价或持续免费计划。
